wins: Completed initial external reconnaissance covering all open TCP ports for host 10.0.0.5, providing data for follow-up phases
Captured detailed service banners (e.g., Apache 2.4.54, OpenSSH 9.3), enabling targeted attack surface profiling
fails: Could not pivot into internal network due to repeated failure to exploit privilege escalation on Linux target (sudo misconfiguration not leveraged)
Multiple attempts to compromise Windows domain controller services ended without lateral movement, leading to 0% success rate
High reliance on mentor calls (15 total) indicates lack of confident automation/path selection
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase yielded rich data, but exploit and post-exploit phases repeatedly stalled, preventing mission completion and leaving lateral objectives unmet

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts using default sudo rights on linux_host failed (no sudo edit rights, commands returned 'sorry, user not allowed')

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 responds with HTTP status 200
skill_cards.then_action: Extract HTTP headers and probe for web server info via curl and nikto

skill_cards.if_condition: When anonymous FTP login is accepted
skill_cards.then_action: List directories, download README files, and search for configuration files

memory_ops.reason: High utility in initial enumeration phase with consistent results
Enabled rapid extraction of application stack details for follow-up exploitation

next_experiments.description: Target the linux_host with linpeas output; attempt abuse of SUDO_ALIASES and use sudoedit on writable configs identified in /etc/sudoers.d

next_experiments.title: Experiment 2: Windows service misconfiguration chaining
next_experiments.description: Enumerate Windows service accounts via nmap smb scripts, then attempt token impersonation against the identified high-privilege service

next_experiments.title: Experiment 3: Mentor-reduction automation
next_experiments.description: Implement automated decision tree to select next module (recon/exploit) based on prior success rates to reduce mentor calls below 5
